diagnosis: The merchant charges listing endpoint retrieves customer payments from Stripe Connect using stripe_account=account_id. It authenticates the requesting user but never verifies that user.stripe_account_id matches account_id, exposing customer names and billing amounts from third-party merchant accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /merchants/acct_rival_merchant_881/charges?limit=50 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.payportal.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_token>
